static_traits.name: Chen Ming
static_traits.family_status: 两个Male孩的Mother，前夫偶尔来访
static_traits.social_status: 有几位朋友可倾诉，但觉得他们可能not理解作为Mother被低估的复杂处境
static_traits.medical_history: not yet曾面临类似问题；without既往心理治疗/心理问题史；without显著身体疾病
static_traits.language_features: 语气中性、表达清晰；能具体描述事件与感受；存在将问题个人化与use“应该”句式的倾向；配合度较高

basic_info.main_problem: 自从前夫回到城里探访后，我觉得两个儿子not愿意再和我待在一起，这让我产生了作为父母的not足感以及被排斥的感觉。
basic_info.core_demands: 'I just want them to want to be with me again. I want to feel like I'm an important part of their lives.' (I hope they will once again want to be with me. I hope I am an important part of their lives.)

special_situations.event: The ex-husband returns to town to visit; the two sons prefer to be with him
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果孩子更愿意和父亲在一起，就说明我作为Mothernot够好、我not重要
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Proactively talks with the children about one's feelings, trying to gain their attention and explanations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们not想要我，我是个not称职的Mother

special_situations.event: 孩子与父亲外出时have not主动向我更新他们的活动安排
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果孩子not主动告知行程，说明他们not尊重我、我在家里的地位很低
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: In my mind I set rules for the children and require them to report activities to me 'at the very least'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们至少应该告诉我他们在做什么

special_situations.event: After expressing feelings to the children, the children dismissively say they just miss their father
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的感受得not到重视，就证明我太敏感/在抱怨
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stops bringing the matter up again to avoid being seen as complaining
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我太敏感了，最好not要再说了

special_situations.event: Notices that the ex-husband is seen as the 'fun parent', while I am responsible for maintaining housework and order
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not是“有趣的”，就not值得孩子喜欢和亲近
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 拿自己与前夫not断比较并贬低自我

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被孩子依恋与重视
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被忽视、被排除在家庭之外，失去作为Mother的价值感
defense_goal: 通过自我克制与not再提出需求来避免Being rejected的痛苦
降低情感表达以维持表面和谐

object_relations.self_representation: 被冷落的旁观者、感到not被重视的Mother
object_relations.object_representation: The child (and ex-husband) are people who prefer the father and ignore me

object_relations.self_representation: not够有趣、只会维持秩序的Mother
object_relations.object_representation: 父亲是受孩子喜爱的“有趣者”

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about the child preferring to be with the father, or being asked about one's feelings in the parent-child relationship
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 担心自己在抱怨、会被评判为过于敏感，因此not配表达需求（将自我评价降低以避免外界deny）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气克制、避免直接表达not满，更多use自责性表述（如“是我太敏感了”），降低情绪强度。

manifestations: Feels like an 'outsider', excluded in her own home
Interaction with children decreases, the subjective experience of being ignored worsens
对自己作为Mother的角色价值产生怀疑

contact_model.definition: 个体存在not良的自我Reflection与自我苛责，过于小心谨慎地接触他人与情境。
manifestations: 自责为“太敏感”“像在抱怨”
降低自我表达以避免被评判

contact_model.definition: Turns the energy originally intended for outward expression back onto oneself, restrains actions or requests toward others.
manifestations: 停止再提及自己的感受与需求
not再与孩子讨论此事以避免冲突

contact_model.definition: not yet经消化地将外界规则与期待当作自己的绝对标准。
manifestations: use“他们至少应该……”的规则性语言
Demands the child's behavior by 'should' standards while ignoring situational differences

positive_force: Previously close with the children, able to play games and watch movies together
愿意主动沟通并寻求专业咨询帮助
Has some social support (several friends to confide in)
negative_force: Sets rigid rules with 'should' statements, dependent on external evaluation
与前夫进行not利的比较，贬低自我
Low mood and decreased motivation，影响日常功能与互动

antecedent: 孩子更愿意与父亲相处
孩子not yet主动更新活动安排
与孩子沟通后被轻描淡写回应
target_behavior.core_reason: 将孩子的选择个人化、以“应该”规则解释关系并与前夫比较，导致被拒感与Self-denial
target_behavior.function: 逃避Being rejected的痛苦、通过自责获得可控感
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased motivation、完成日常任务困难、与孩子互动减少、Impaired self-esteem

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding further communication with the children (stopping bringing up needs and feelings)
antecedent: After communicating with children, feels worse and worries about being seen as complaining
害怕被评判为过于敏感
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕Being rejected与被评判，将外向的愤怒/失落Turning against the self
target_behavior.function: Avoids conflict and negative evaluation to maintain surface harmony
target_behavior.consequence: Parent-child relationship further alienated, subjective sense of exclusion worsens
